_doc: 类别卡（跨区的类别级知识，2026-10-04 建）。primitives / forbidden 迁自 GEM economic_priors 的 CATEGORY_PRIMITIVES / CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN（测试守内容不丢）；cross_region 只收 ≥2 个区复现的结论，单区证据写进 tracking/<R>/config/cells.json。生成侧全局禁止项在 wqb.profiles.locked.GLOBAL_FORBIDDEN。查看合成后的生效画像：$WQ_PY -m wqb.profiles explain --region <R> --category <c>

s4_levers.what: 判「无解 / 天花板」前先扫等价算子替换：signed_power → quantile、ts_scale → quantile / normalize。数值路径不同，一次动多个闸（含 prod，要读全部闸）
s4_levers.evidence: KOR other466 signed_power→quantile：2Y 1.51→1.56、prod 0.6544→0.6397；GLB quantile 替 ts_scale：S +0.20、F +0.06、prod 0.475→0.565（DEC-72）
s4_levers.note: 效应量逐区实测，禁外推；quantile 只收 1 个参数

s4_levers.what: 强但撞 prod 墙的快信号：用一个经济子集门控（trade_when 进 >0.5 出 <0.4 的慢变量，或 rank(cap)>0.2 ∩ 子集）只在子集里持仓
s4_levers.precondition: 未门控的基础信号 IS sharpe 不低于 2.5、fitness 不低于 1.5（GLB 2026-09-27 铁律：门控只修 prod / robust，不造强度）；慢信号门控后换手会升，只用于快信号

notes: prod 与 self 两个端点都取 max、都过线才可提；不改持仓的降 prod 杠杆（hump、加大 decay）会把 self 推爆（EUR wave274）
设置是强度闸：nanHandling / maxTrade / decay / 中性化换档等于换信号，跨档结果不可比（IND 行为族 S 2.19→0.46）
decay 匹配信号速度：快信号上 decay 越大越差；decay 0 与 1 逐位相同，只留一个
prod 墙先看直方图分单颗钉子 / 密墙 / 可破三型，再决定换分母、换设置档或分组轴（决策表 D0-P 诊断前置）

model.title: 模型 / 打分类（预训练因子、ML 预测、评级分数）
model.field_profile: 分数水平、分位标签（*_quantile / probability_label）、预测收益；多为日频或周频更新，常见 VECTOR；生命周期衰减快
s1_hints: 分清分数水平与分位 / 概率标签：标签类在 GBR 2Y 崩（GBR-DLRISKFREE-LABEL-DEAD）
看字段 description 判断是不是别人做好的成品因子；成品因子的热门字段 prod 墙最硬

cross_region.what: 成品模型分数的热门字段在多区撞 prod 墙（users 高的字段 prod 必超上限）
cross_region.evidence: GLB techindi_model predicted_first_quantile 系 qMNZX1o1 prod 0.7686（GLB profile）；USA mdl177 / book-value 145 颗同族 ACTIVE；EUR×model 62 条判死

primitives: industry residual: group_zscore so the factor is not the sector bet
quality minus yield: a slow fundamental residual, not the raw score
invert only when the economic story is crowding or mean-reversion
never ship a lone rank(model_score) as a concept
model disagreement: ensemble variance across model outputs
regime conditional: model signal only in specific market regimes
forbidden: 禁止使用裸 rank(model_score)（必须 group_neutralize 或 industry residual）

pv.title: 量价 / 微观结构
pv.field_profile: 日频量价（pv1）+ 分钟级派生（intraday_pv_feats：pre_close 30m、last trade、twap/vwap）+ 残差收益（pv47 UBER 残差）
s1_hints: 各区可用性差异大：先查本区有没有 pv1（JPN TOP1600 没有，close / adv20 / returns 不可用）
intraday_pv_feats 目录字段 ≠ 平台可用字段：先单字段探针再成批

cross_region.what: 日内价量相关反转 / 尾盘反转 IS 很强，但裸用 prod 0.79–0.99；只有加门控才可能破墙（见全局杠杆 subset_gate）
cross_region.evidence: IND intraday_pv_feats prod 0.79–0.92、pv103 外部孪生 1.0（IND profile）；GLB / ASI 门控模板（2026-09-21 实证）

cross_region.what: 日内微观结构的非反转机制普遍弱（max |S| 约 1.0，或撞 fitness 墙）
cross_region.evidence: JPN w8 16 条 max|S| 1.02；USA-IPV-CORR-PRECLOSE-FITNESS-WALL-20260921；GBR-INTRADAY-MICRO-WEAK；IND 未点亮塔实证

cross_region.what: 图表形态族（pattern_scores / continuation_score / chart_cnn）
cross_region.evidence: KOR 三连死（chart_cnn 1.51 → continuation 0.34 → pattern_scores 0.49）；GBR-SIMPLE-STRUCTURE-DEAD；DEU-PATTERN_SCORES-PROBE-DEAD-20261002；AMR 红榜

primitives: continuation vs reversal: short-horizon pattern vs longer mean
intraday vs overnight: session-specific pressure
volume-conditioned return: price move that happened on unusual volume
fast+slow interaction must be ONE coherent signal (ratio / ts_corr / conditional), never a weighted sum of two legs
volatility regime: high-vol vs low-vol period signal divergence
liquidity shock: volume spike vs historical average (ts_zscore of volume)
price efficiency: bid-ask spread or price impact proxy
forbidden: 禁止使用加权混合（0.4*rank(A) + 0.6*rank(B) / add(multiply(0.4,A),multiply(0.6,B))）
禁止使用 ts_entropy / ts_skewness（幽灵算子）

analyst.title: 分析师预期 / 评级
analyst.field_profile: 一致预期（mean_estimate / flash）、修正、离散度、评级；VECTOR 为主；更新频率月 / 季
s1_hints: 分清 actual_*（已实现、事后）与 mean_estimate_* / flash（预测、前瞻）：IND analyst_consensus 前 16 条全灭的真因是用了 actual（DEC-77）
VECTOR 先 vec_avg / vec_count 聚合；JPN 下 vec_* 外再套 ts_* 会报错

cross_region.what: flash / pretax 一致预期动量族只在 IND 有效，别的区 |S| 都在 1.07 以下
cross_region.evidence: waves probe_flash_eps_20260919 / probe_pretax_20260919：USA ≤0.09、GLB ≤0.08、HKG 0.64、KOR ≤1.07、EUR ≤0.96、DEU ≤0.72、GBR ≤0.54

cross_region.what: 分析师主信号族普遍撞 prod 墙
cross_region.evidence: KOR analyst10/16/44/consensus（RULES §G）；USA-ANALYST44-BREADTH-DEAD-EP-PRODWALL（E/P z prod 0.93）；DEU analyst93 prod 饱和

primitives: revision surprise: change in FY1/FY2 vs the stale level
dispersion: disagreement across estimates, not the consensus mean
breadth vs magnitude: how many estimates moved, not how far the mean moved
horizon gap: FY2 minus FY1 as a growth-expectation residual
rating momentum: upgrade/downgrade frequency vs historical baseline
target price gap: current price vs consensus target (upside/downside)
estimate acceleration: second derivative of estimate revisions
forbidden: 禁止使用裸 rank(estimate)（必须 ts_delta 或 group_zscore）

earnings.title: 财报事件 / 盈余意外
earnings.field_profile: 事件 / 日历型（距财报天数、意外值、电话会），稀疏
s1_hints: ern3_pre_interval 是负天数编码：less(x, -5) 表示财报后超过 5 天（IND 实测）
稀疏事件直接作主信号易 CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT / 高换手

cross_region.what: earnings3 的日历 / 计时字段作主信号判死，只能作条件（计时）腿
cross_region.evidence: IND-EARNINGS3-TIMING-DEAD；MEA-EARNINGS3-CALENDAR-DEAD

primitives: earnings surprise: actual vs consensus (standardized unexpected earnings)
earnings revision: post-earnings estimate changes
earnings quality: accruals vs cash flow divergence
guidance vs consensus: management guidance vs analyst estimates
earnings momentum: year-over-year growth acceleration
earnings call sentiment: tone analysis of earnings call transcripts

fundamental.title: 财报基本面
fundamental.field_profile: 季频 / 年频财报科目与比率；覆盖要 ts_backfill 补
s1_hints: 低频字段窗口取 66 / 252，补覆盖用 ts_backfill(·, 66)（季频）或 252（年频）（决策表 D5 / D6）
比率型信号的分母口径往往决定 self / prod 与 2Y——先看分母

cross_region.what: 换分母在 KOR 是破 self / prod 墙的主杠杆，在 EUR 是毒药——不作类别级规则，按组合取用
cross_region.evidence: KOR other466 只换分母 self 0.7422→0.6244、prod 0.8061→0.6843；EUR value_investment 换分母 S 0.10 全灭（WorkBuddy MEMORY §1.2 / §1.7）

cross_region.what: 慢变的经典基本面单因子（value / quality / book 及其线性变体）判死或 prod 饱和
cross_region.evidence: USA seed basics 全族死、book/value 145 颗同族 ACTIVE；KOR 慢变基本面族 fnd86/89/93/f21 四连死

primitives: accrual / cash gap: earnings quality, not the earnings level
leverage change: delta of debt or interest burden
efficiency: turnover or incremental margin, not the stock of assets
invert value only as a residual after industry neutralization
asset growth: delta of total assets vs revenue growth (efficiency)
margin trajectory: gross margin change vs operating margin change
capital allocation: capex vs depreciation (growth vs maintenance)
forbidden: 禁止使用裸 rank(fundamental_score)（必须 group_neutralize 或 group_zscore）

news.title: 新闻
news.field_profile: VECTOR、稀疏、事件驱动（计数 / 语气 / 新颖度）
s1_hints: VECTOR 稀疏：vec_count / vec_avg 后再进常规算子；直接用易 CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT
深挖（5 家族 × 6 桶）走 brain-alpha-research-news-sentiment

cross_region.what: 新闻 / 情绪作主信号在多区同型全灭（robust 墙、CW 或换手墙）
cross_region.evidence: AMR profile 跨区负先验；KOR 新闻情绪四连死（news38/50/54/79）；IND sentiment21 robust 0.24；GLB-NEWS23-MNA-EVENT-DEAD、GLB news73 sentiment 判死

cross_region.what: 新闻计数作子集门控腿有效（主信号仍来自别的类别）
cross_region.evidence: ASI normalized_news_article_count、GLB vec_count(nws73_headlines)（2026-09-21 门控模板）

cross_region.what: emotion 系（含 sentiment / mood 命名的变体）跨区死路
cross_region.evidence: GLB 铁律（registry cross_region 层）；KOR / HKG / AMR profile 排除

primitives: disagreement: primary vs secondary / source A vs source B sentiment
intensity-weighted tone: sentiment scaled by item count or novelty
revision of tone: ts_delta of backfilled sentiment, not the level
skew / polarization: fat-tail of sentiment vs the mean
event clustering: news count spikes vs baseline (ts_zscore of count)
source credibility: tier-1 vs tier-2 source sentiment divergence
forbidden: 禁止使用 ts_entropy / ts_skewness / ts_percentage / ts_decay_exp_window（幽灵算子，整批 CANCELLED 连坐）
禁止使用裸 rank(sentiment_score)（必须 group_neutralize 或 ts_delta）

sentiment.title: 情绪 / 社媒
sentiment.field_profile: 情绪分、关注度、社媒热度；多为 VECTOR 或稀疏 MATRIX
s1_hints: 关注度冲击常是反向信号（IND news_sentiment_transfer 1.64 反号）

cross_region.what: 新闻 / 情绪作主信号在多区同型全灭（robust 墙、CW 或换手墙）
cross_region.evidence: AMR profile 跨区负先验；KOR 新闻情绪四连死（news38/50/54/79）；IND sentiment21 robust 0.24；GLB-NEWS23-MNA-EVENT-DEAD、GLB news73 sentiment 判死

cross_region.what: emotion 系（含 sentiment / mood 命名的变体）跨区死路
cross_region.evidence: GLB 铁律（registry cross_region 层）；KOR / HKG / AMR profile 排除

primitives: disagreement and intensity, not the raw score
change in sentiment after backfill, not the snapshot
sentiment divergence: retail vs institutional sentiment gap
sentiment persistence: autocorrelation of sentiment changes

insiders.title: 内部人交易
insiders.field_profile: 稀疏事件矩阵（交易笔数 / 方向 / 金额）
primitives: 交易方向与规模：净买入 / 净卖出，取负放在 rank 之后并保持零均值（决策表 D6）
持续性：内部人连续同向交易的次数，而不是单次交易
相对：按行业 / 市值分组比较，避免把行业交易季节性当信号
s1_hints: 稀疏事件矩阵作主信号常撞 CW / 稀疏墙

cross_region.what: insiders 数据集作主信号天花板低
cross_region.evidence: KOR insiders5 1.05、insider_feats prod 0.7185；DEU insider_trx_matrix 0.33；USA-INSIDER-MATRIX-SPARSE-EVENT-WALL；EUR-INSIDER-AGG-MATRIX-COLD-ZERO-YIELD

institutions.title: 机构持仓
institutions.field_profile: 季频持仓快照（持股比例、持有人数）
s1_hints: 季频慢变量：适合当 trade_when 慢开关（进 >0.5 出 <0.4 的滞回带），不适合当快信号

cross_region.what: institutions6 作主信号判死；作慢门控腿可用（IND levk5JYN：机构持股比例 rank>0.5，prod 0.55）
cross_region.evidence: IND institutions6 best 0.32；ASI 死名单；KOR 红榜；EUR-INSTITUTIONS6-COLD-ZERO-YIELD

primitives: owner change vs owner level: flow, not the stale holding
concentration vs breadth of holders
country/industry relative ownership, not a screening flag
institutional momentum: new positions vs closed positions
ownership stability: long-term holders vs short-term traders

shortinterest.title: 卖空 / 借券
shortinterest.field_profile: 卖空量 / 金额、借券费率、利用率；常有累积口径与当日口径两套
s1_hints: YYYYMMDD 交易日字段（如 KOR shrt38_stk_invacttd_drt）不是信号
累积口径偏 2Y、当日口径偏 IS（KOR shortinterest38 实证，作选区先验，不作类别结论）

cross_region.what: shortinterest5 价带宽度在 TOP500 级宇宙没有横截面离散度
cross_region.evidence: IND-SHORTINTEREST5-PRICEBAND-DEAD；ASI-SI5-MCR63-RSK70-CORRGATE-WEAK-20260921

primitives: short interest change: delta of short interest vs float
short squeeze potential: high short interest + positive catalyst
short covering: rapid decline in short interest
days to cover: short interest vs average daily volume
short interest momentum: acceleration of short interest changes

risk.title: 风险模型 / 因子载荷
risk.field_profile: 因子载荷、残差收益、借券 / 拥挤度指标

cross_region.what: risk70 族判死（族连坐 risk88）
cross_region.evidence: KOR RULES §G；ASI 死名单（2026-09-21）

cross_region.what: 风险模型残差反转：KOR / GBR / GLB 上 2Y 翻号、因子暴露或偏弱，IND other532 特质收益反转却是 S 3.66——只作提醒，按组合取用
cross_region.evidence: KOR-RISK71-RESIDUAL-REVERSAL-2Y-DEAD；GBR-PV47-RESIDUAL-REVERSAL-PRODSAT（rn 0.20）；GLB-RISK68-RESIDUAL-REVERSAL-WEAK-20260927；IND gJZwVXVm（WorkBuddy MEMORY §1.6）

cross_region.what: 借券费率 / 做空利用率作门控腿有效；作主信号 prod 高
cross_region.evidence: GLB 门控 rsk60_offer、mdl239_combo_utilisation（2026-09-21）；EUR risk60 借券费主信号 prod 0.905（2026-09-19）

primitives: tail risk: skewness or kurtosis of return distribution
drawdown risk: maximum drawdown vs historical average
correlation breakdown: pairwise correlation vs historical average
volatility clustering: GARCH effects or volatility persistence
liquidity risk: bid-ask spread or Amihud illiquidity measure

option.title: 期权
option.field_profile: 隐含波动率曲面、成交 / 持仓量、Greeks

cross_region.what: 期权 IV 概念族弱或撞 fitness 天花板
cross_region.evidence: USA-OPTION40-IV-SURFACE-WEAK（≤1.12）；IND option30 fitness ≤0.85、option1 判死；DEU / GBR option1 红榜

primitives: implied volatility skew: put-call IV difference (tail risk pricing)
volatility term structure: short-dated vs long-dated IV
option flow: unusual volume or open interest changes
put-call ratio: sentiment indicator from option positioning
gamma exposure: dealer hedging pressure from option Greeks

other.title: 其它（杂项桶：先按字段含义归到具体思路）
other.field_profile: 杂项：财务比率、残差收益、网络嵌入、注意力、宏观等混在一起
primitives: name the priced risk first; the operator is secondary
先按字段 description 判断经济含义，再套对应类别卡的思路（例：KOR other466 是财务比率 → fundamental；IND other532 是 Barra 特质收益 → 残差反转）
s1_hints: 数据集名会骗人：必读字段 description；稀疏高 valueScore 是陷阱

cross_region.what: other455 网络嵌入（n2v）族
cross_region.evidence: KOR RULES §G；EUR-W253-OTHER455-CUSTOMER-NETWORK-RETURNS；DEU-OTH455-PURECOMP-SUBUNIVERSE-WALL-20260923；GBR 红榜
